baseline_controls.historical_cards_policy: Do not fabricate missing historical full-card attributes.

principles: Preserve the locked hierarchy and target OVR; never inflate unrelated traits to match it.
Use the existing season-phase-aware Full Audit gate without weakening evidence standards.
Evaluate each trait independently, explain why not higher/lower, and preserve evidenced weaknesses.
Same-OVR players require distinct supported builds; archetypes describe completed cards.
Use exact-trait 90/95/97/99 standards; never prescribe a quota or normalize every elite QB upward.
Explicit user approval is required for every transition beyond PROPOSED in this reconstruction workflow.
No engine formula, editor order, or historical full-card values are inferred.

evidence_domains.arm_strength: Evaluate usable velocity/distance separately from downfield placement.
evidence_domains.short_accuracy: Chart short placement by difficulty, throw type and sample.
evidence_domains.intermediate_accuracy: Chart intermediate windows, anticipation and placement.
evidence_domains.deep_accuracy: Chart deep placement with separation, pressure and sample uncertainty.
evidence_domains.pressure_performance: Separate execution under pressure from protection and decisions.
evidence_domains.pocket_movement: Evaluate footwork, spatial awareness and platform recovery without conflating contact escapes.
evidence_domains.sack_avoidance: Separate pressure avoidance, decisions, protection, release and actual sack-contact breaks.
evidence_domains.processing_decision_making: Evaluate reads, anticipation, risk and situational decisions; reputation is context only.
evidence_domains.play_action: Separate fake execution from scheme-generated production.
evidence_domains.throws_on_run: Evaluate passing while moving by direction, platform and depth; rushing is not a substitute.
evidence_domains.scrambling: Separate unplanned rushing decisions, space creation, speed and outcomes.
evidence_domains.designed_rushing: Separate designed carries and sneaks from scrambles/kneeldowns; control for blocking and opportunities.
evidence_domains.ball_security: Separate carrying fumbles, strip sacks and exchange failures from interceptions.
evidence_domains.durability: Use sourced injury history and exposure without diagnosing or inventing medical certainty.
evidence_domains.workload_availability: Account for snaps, practice, role, missed time, rest and current readiness.
evidence_domains.consistency: Track repeatability and trend over meaningful samples; do not duplicate total production.
evidence_domains.opponent_context_adjustments: Record opponent quality, coverage, protection, receivers, scheme, game state, weather and sample differences; no invented adjustment coefficients.

THP.football_meaning: Ball velocity and usable distance from repeatable quarterback mechanics.
THP.madden_gameplay_effect: Intended to represent throwing power; exact velocity/distance response must be measured.
supporting_evidence: Contextual film of far-hash and deep throws
Measured ball velocity with method and release context
forbidden_substitutes: Passing yards or deep completions alone
Arm size, reputation or desired OVR
THP.expected_confidence: Aim for HIGH from independent contextual evidence and sufficient sample. MEDIUM requires explicit review; LOW blocks validation. HIGH is required for 90+.
THP.gameplay_role: Core QB execution/processing dimension in this analytical framework; material OVR impact must be established empirically.

scarcity.90: THP: Demonstrably elite exact-trait performance against relevant league peers, supported by a meaningful sample.
scarcity.95: THP: Rare league-defining exact-trait evidence; high confidence and explicit peer separation required.
scarcity.97: THP: Extraordinary league-defining exact-trait evidence with sustained separation; not a reputation award.
scarcity.99: THP: Historically exceptional/generational exact-trait evidence with explicit historical comparison; never an overall-player award.

engine_source_notes.scope: Primary EA documentation for Madden 26 CPU awareness/processing and separate decision tendencies. Historical engine context only; does not verify Madden 27 OVR weights, distance bins, thresholds or editor order. No EA player ratings used.

research_instructions:
Collect a thorough current phase-aware evidence package for ONLY Matthew Stafford. Do not assign any Madden ratings or OVR. Never use EA ratings as evidence. Do not audit another player; peer statistical comparisons are allowed.
Use official NFL/Rams statistics and current roster/injury/practice reports, NGS, reputable public advanced data, pressure/sack and depth/accuracy metrics, publicly available film-supported scouting. Cover completed regular season plus its postseason when the application-derived phase is preseason/offseason. Resolve provider disagreements by season, sample, definitions and scope, never averaging inconsistent figures.
Use all required normalized categories from the adapter. Within normalized.position_specific_traits ALSO return domain_assessments keyed by each of: arm_strength, short_accuracy, intermediate_accuracy, deep_accuracy, pressure_performance, pocket_movement, sack_avoidance, processing_decision_making, play_action, throws_on_run, scrambling, designed_rushing, ball_security, durability, workload_availability, consistency, opponent_context_adjustments; AND trait_assessments keyed by THP, SAC, MAC, DAC, RUN, TUP, PAC, BSK, AWR, SPD, ACC, AGI, COD, STR, CAR, JMP, INJ, STA, TGH.
Each nested assessment must be {status:'satisfied'|'partial'|'missing',confidence:'HIGH'|'MEDIUM'|'LOW',items:[{claim,source_url,retrieved_at,season,period:'REGULAR_SEASON'|'POSTSEASON'|'CURRENT_CONTEXT'}],limitations:[specific missing data and strongest public substitute]}. These nested maps belong INSIDE position_specific_traits, not extra normalized categories. Include normal status/confidence/items/limitations on that parent category too.
Every nested claim must cite a source also included in sources, actual retrieval timestamp, evidence season and sample/context. Include direct current evidence or explain uncertainty for speed, acceleration, agility, change of direction, strength, jumping, carrying, injury, stamina and toughness; no character judgments, old combine results as current truth, or guessed physical measurements. Current role/availability is not a substitute for strength/jump/toughness measurement. Incomplete traits must remain partial/missing with honest confidence.
Research every domain even if one is missing. Make a reasonable focused search for strongest public substitutes when premium splits/film/metrics are unavailable. Record exact remaining gaps, not generic 'more research needed'. Distinguish sack avoidance vs broken sack contact, pressure execution vs processing, play-action skill vs scheme, and on-run passing vs mobility.
Compare all stored Top10 names and all three outside controls using comparable sourced football evidence, but identify their full cards as unreconstructed. Never invent their attribute values. Stafford's stored ceiling position is a constraint, not an independent proof of current superiority or an OVR target to fit.
Set minimum_evidence_met false for incomplete necessary evidence, insufficient sample or unresolved material conflicts. Do not weaken requirements. Do not run project commands, write files, approve, persist or change state. Return structured JSON after a thorough but bounded research pass. Use a single response even if the honest result is insufficient evidence.
